notes.title: Solo Soul Ring 6.6 major update
notes.content:
Solo Soul Ring QQ group: 1106801820 add a group to contact me for screenshot to get different gear compensation

Add archive encryption technology. The original archive is invalid. It is hereby compensated.

Compensation official filing of chapters I to VII. Chapter 1 to 7 are archived without receiving the reward of contribution hall. Have the skill of colored eggs. The archive is automatically owned after the update.

Mobile games can receive mobile compensation gift packs for 8 hours.

If the plot is pushed to Chapter 6 and the level reaches 130 to 199, you can get the first level compensation.

Level increased by 60, 12 epic souls. A broken soul. 3 terrarian stones 100 evil king invitations. 100 girl memory fragments. 1 women's cloth. 5 optional gift packs of tier 2 gems. 50W gold coins

If the plot is pushed to Chapter 6 and the level reaches 200 to 299, you can get the second level compensation.

Level increased by 160, 24 epic souls. 2 broken souls. 6 terrarian stones 200 evil kings invited. 200 girl memory fragments. 2 women's fabrics. 10 second level gems optional gift bag. 100W gold coins

If the story is pushed to Chapter 6 and the level reaches 300 to 399, you can get the third level compensation.

Level increased by 260, 36 epic souls. 3 broken souls. 9 terrarian stones 300 evil king invitations. 300 girl memory fragments. 3 women's fabrics. 15 second level gems optional gift bag. 150W gold coins

If the plot is pushed to Chapter 6 and the level reaches 400 to 499, you can get the fourth level compensation.

Level increased by 360, 48 epic souls. 4 broken souls. 12 stones of tararia 400 evil king invitations. 400 girl memory fragments. 4 women's fabrics. 20 second level gems optional gift bag. 200W gold coins

If the plot is pushed to Chapter 6 and the level reaches above 500J, the fifth level compensation will be received.

Level increased by 460, 60 epic souls. Five broken souls. 15 terrarian stones 500 evil king invitations. 500 girl memory fragments. 5 women's fabrics. 25 second level gems optional gift bag. 250W gold coins

In addition, two level III abyss pearl optional gift bags will be presented.

Increases spell fusion damage. Maximum HP percentage damage increased by 5% Magic attack rate increased by 2 times.

Increase the damage rate of all skills of rimeng. And maximum health percentage damage.

Reduce most of the soul power bonus damage of secret skills. Reduce the percentage damage of secret skill blood relay limit.

Modify the night Kai skill. After using it, you will enter a weak state, and the full feature will be changed to physical. (no adjustment for injury)

Add school training room. You can fight with players to gain credits.

Add Royal College suit. A new secret. You can exchange credits in the student union.

Add music room. You can find music teacher isamara (provided by the group member Yulong Snow Mountain) to gain experience with gold coins. Exchange materials for credits.

Reduce the difficulty for underground cave 2 to reach the land of dragon balls.

Increase the price of oral liquid.
